summary: Looks up a key=value string in a global string table (dword_8D3E90). The lookup proceeds only once the parse flag dword_8D5A48 is set; if the table is not yet built, it is populated from the wide-string list dword_8D3E98 via WideCharMultiByteStringConversionWithAllocLoop. For a non-null key, iterates the table entries, and for each entry whose length exceeds the key length, whose character at the key-length offset is '=' (61), and that matches the key case-insensitively via MbsnbicollCRTStringCollation, returns a pointer to the value just after the '='. Returns NULL when no entry matches or a guard fails.

operations.description: v1 = dword_8D3E90 loads the string-table pointer.
Return NULL when the parse/init flag dword_8D5A48 is zero.

If the table pointer dword_8D3E90 is NULL, require dword_8D3E98 (wide-string list) to be non-null and populate the table via WideCharMultiByteStringConversionWithAllocLoop(); then require the resulting dword_8D3E90 to be non-null.
Return NULL when the search key lpString2 is NULL.
v2 = Strlen(lpString2) measures the key length; every subsequent comparison uses this length.
Walk the string table while (*v1); each entry is a pointer to a null-terminated string.
Skip the entry when Strlen(*v1) <= v2 (entry is not longer than the key).
Skip the entry when the character at entry[v2] is not '=' (61), so it is not a key=value pair for this key length.
Match the key case-insensitively: MbsnbicollCRTStringCollation(*v1, lpString2, v2) returns 0 on match.
Return &entry[v2 + 1], the pointer to the value just after the '=' separator.
Return NULL (0) when no entry matches or a guard fails.

unresolved: The exact role of the returned value substring and how the caller sub_5921F3 (0x005921F3) consumes it is out of scope.
Ownership of the global string table (dword_8D3E90) and wide-string list (dword_8D3E98) is unknown; the lookup is treated as a free function over module globals.
